notes.title: Rocket Frog Version 1.0.4 Is Available Now!
notes.content:
Greetings to all players of Rocket Frog,

The Rocket Frog Version 1.0.4 update is available now, and has some NEW CHANGES!!!

Ver. 1.0.4 Release Notes
Gameplay

Japanese Translation has been added! You can now select from either Japanese or English from the options menu!

Game Performance Improvements: Levels have been optimized to improve frame rate and gameplay.


Thank you for playing Rocket Frog!

notes.title: Rocket Frog Version 1.0.3 Has Now Released!
notes.content:
Greetings to all players of Rocket Frog far and near,

The Rocket Frog Version 1.0.3 update is out now, and has IMPORTANT CHANGES!!!

Ver. 1.0.3 Release Notes
Gameplay

Story Mode and Arcade Mode added!

Story Mode: This will be an easier mode of gameplay! It will Save Level Progress and have Continue Points from the Level you were last on!

Arcade Mode: This mode will be a Harder Challenge! It has NO Continue Points and NO Saved Level Progression!


Let me know if you have any issues, and thank you for playing Rocket Frog!

notes.title: Rocket Frog Version 1.0.2 Has Released!
notes.content:
Greetings to all players of Rocket Frog,

Rocket Frog Version 1.0.2 is now available, and shall be sent out into the wild!

Ver. 1.0.2 Release Notes
Graphics

Fixed issue where color of top and bottom in cutscenes did not match.

Fixed issue where some Tiles were misplaced.


Gameplay

Added more platforms to the end of Level 1.1 and the beginning of Level 3.1
 to make them a bit easier.


Let me know if you have any issues, and thank you for playing Rocket Frog!
